note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The registry, its reference and every date are fictional, supplied placeholders: nothing states a filing rule, fee, court, admissibility, deadline or any effect of registering or not filing. 'Draft, not filed' is only a different configured state of this example.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Party A signs the fictional written filing and pushes it out of her drafts tray into the registry intake tray; the clerk stamps its reference box: Ref. REG-0417 (fictional) appears and an entry glyph drops into Day 2 (as supplied) of the registry calendar.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the filing is signed but not handed in (draft, not filed — as supplied). It stays in Party A's drafts tray, its reference box stays blank and the clerk does not move; the calendar slots stay empty (neutral). Different parties and documents.
